Post: Manifest It and It Will Come
PostSummary: Short videos promise that if you visualize hard enough, repeat affirmations, and act as if you already have it, the universe will deliver wealth, love, or success. The trend treats thoughts as a force that bends reality to your wishes.
BiblicalResponse: Desire itself is not wrong, and prayer is powerful, but the Bible never teaches that our thoughts control the universe. God is sovereign, not a force we manipulate; prayer is asking a loving Father whose will is wiser than our wishes. Ask boldly, work diligently, and trust His answer even when it differs from the vision board.
